name: agent_learning_graph_render_build_chart_buckets
notes: Links the REAL port (learning_graph_render.o::learning_graph_render_build_chart_buckets). Harness traces B1(nodes empty)/B2(untimed) then summarizes each bucket as label|ts|skills|memories|rec|node-ids; twin drives LIVE _build_chart_buckets identically. Inputs restricted to the agreed region: untimed inputs keep rec values non-decreasing in node order (LIVE sorts by rec, C iterates unsorted — stable sort makes them agree); timestamps numeric only (C lg_ts uses strtod on strings, a documented narrowing); max_rows always positive (LIVE returns [] for <=0 in the untimed path while C clamps to 1 bin — divergence avoided).
